artworks.title: Study of a Woman
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated in profile on a chair. She is leaning forward with her elbows on her thighs and hands clasped together. Her head is slightly bowed and turned to the side, showing her facial profile. The woman has subtle facial features and her hair is in a bun. She wears a long dark dress and a checkered apron tied around her waist. Her green shoes or socks are visible beneath her dress. The background is plain and sketchy lines suggest furniture she is seated on.

artworks.title: Return from the Wash House (Retour de lavoir)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of three women depicted from the waist up. They are leaning forward and carrying a large cloth bundle or sack together. The central woman faces left, with sharp facial features and short hair styled back. She wears a checked blouse. The woman on the right has soft facial features, hair in a bun, and wears a plain blouse. A third woman in the background has indistinct features and dark hair. The setting is urban, with a street and building facades. The background has beige tones, giving a sepia effect.

artworks.title: From the Sixth Floor
artworks.description: The image depicts an elevated urban street scene at night. The buildings and trees can be seen in the distance under a dark sky. The brushstrokes are soft and blurred, creating a nocturnal atmosphere. The color palette is dark with occasional warm accents. A figure in blue clothing is leaning out next to a railing where a cat sits. Pedestrians and a horse-drawn carriage are visible on the dimly lit streets below.

artworks.title: Portrait of the Artist's Wife
artworks.description: The image is a sketch depicting the upper body of a person. The person is facing slightly to the side, with their head turned towards the viewer. They have long, flowing hair and expressive facial features. The person appears to be wearing a head covering or hat. The drawing emphasizes the facial expression with minimal detail on clothing. The background is blank, with cross-hatched lines enhancing the contrast.

artworks.title: Sa famille (chanson)
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and colored chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated with her back turned, covering her face with her hands. She has dark hair pulled back into a bun and wears a sleeveless dress with a full skirt featuring small black spots. Four other figures are nearby, including a man in a dark suit, a woman with gray hair holding an umbrella, and two men with different facial hair styles and headwear. The background features vertical yellow and blue lines.

artworks.title: La mort des pauvres-Baudelaire
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elongated, luminous figure and three smaller figures in a dark setting. The larger figure is reaching out to the smaller figures. There is a light source in the bottom left, casting a glow in the scene. The drawing features intricate shading and contrasting dark blue hues against the light emitted by the figure, creating a mystical atmosphere. The style suggests an intimate moment with an otherworldly presence.

artworks.title: He Acts Like a Painter
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon
artworks.description: The image displays three men standing on a cobblestone street, observing a man walking away from them. The men are seen from the waist up, with two of them wearing hats—a top hat and another type of formal hat. They have prominent facial features, including large noses and moustaches, and are dressed in long, dark coats. One man on the right holds a cane or walking stick behind his back. The man walking away wears a wide-brimmed hat, a long overcoat, and carries a pack resembling a painter's easel and canvas. In the background, there is a street with traditional buildings, and a partially visible woman around the corner, possibly holding a parasol, wearing a long skirt and a fitted top, next to a window with shutters. The illustration is in black and white, with strong lines and shading for depth and texture.

artworks.title: Sailors' Wives
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of women and children standing on a stone platform overlooking a body of water. The figures are shown from full-length, with the foremost woman holding an umbrella. She has blonde hair and is wearing a white bonnet, a black blouse, and an orange skirt with white floral patterns. Other women and children are dressed similarly in traditional clothing with dark colors and patterns, some wearing bonnets or headscarves. One child is cradled by an older woman with a headscarf. The background shows waves in the water and a softly colored sky.

artworks.title: Fille de Ferme
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and colored crayon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a farmyard scene with chickens. The image includes a young person with short sleeves and a wide-brimmed hat, holding a wooden bucket with feed. They are feeding a group of chickens and roosters scattered on the ground. Some chickens are closer, while others are further away, gathered around a pile of yellow straw or feed in front of a stone structure with a wooden door. Clothes are hanging on a line in the background, with bright blue and white garments adding color to the scene. The drawing uses a limited color palette of yellows, blues, and neutral tones, with detailed pencil lines for texture and depth.

artworks.title: Sheet of Sketches
artworks.description: The image contains a collection of sketches portraying various parts and poses of the human body, focusing mainly on the head and shoulders. The drawings depict people in different positions, including a group embracing each other. Some sketches show detailed facial features and various expressions. The hair styles range from short cuts to long, flowing hair with loose outlines. Clothing is lightly sketched, indicating dresses, robes, and jackets. There is no jewelry depicted. The figures are sometimes holding each other, and the artist's signature "Steinlen" appears at the bottom right corner. The background is plain, emphasizing the intricacies of the sketched figures.

artworks.title: Sketches for "Lovers on a Bench"
artworks.description: The image shows sketches of various figures and scenes. At the top left is a partial upper-body sketch of a person, next to several partial facial sketches. Below are sketches of a woman standing in a three-quarter view, holding an object, and a man in profile. To the right, two figures are depicted in an embrace. Additionally, there are individual facial sketches and busts with different expressions and hairstyles throughout. The background is plain, and the sketch is done in black pencil.

artworks.title: The Coconut Merchant
artworks.description: This is a drawing containing multiple sketches and scenes executed in blue sketching material. There are depictions of various human figures, including a standing nude figure, several children, and different busts or heads of individuals. One prominent scene in the upper right corner shows a bustling group scene that may depict market activity or a gathering with figures and goods or market stalls. The composition appears to be a collection of sketches studying different poses, expressions, or activities, reflecting a practice or preparatory work in art.

artworks.title: C'est ici, chez nous!
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a woman and two children. The woman stands holding a large sack over her shoulder. She wears a headscarf and a long dress. Beside her is a young boy wearing a flat cap and holding a sack, and on the other side is a smaller child holding a case. In the background are sketchy outlines of an architectural structure resembling ruins, with trees and distant figures.

artworks.title: Watching the Crowd
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, black chalk and colored crayon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bustling street scene with animals and people interacting. In the foreground, several dogs are engaging with one another. The background shows people in period clothing, some wearing bowler hats and long coats. The architecture includes tall buildings and window displays. The drawing is signed "Steinlen" in the bottom corner.

artworks.title: Gossips
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures in front of a building. The figures include a man on the left in a patterned shirt and cap, a middle figure leaning on a structure resembling a fence or railing, and a figure on the right interacting with a long rectangular object resembling a plank of wood. The background shows simple building lines and utility poles, suggesting an urban setting. The medium used appears expressive, with soft colors filling the outlines made with ink or pencil. The figures are depicted wearing various types of clothing, with attention to detail in the jackets worn by the left and middle figures, and the short-sleeved shirt worn by the rightmost figure. The drawing style is sketchy, capturing movements and postures with fluidity.

artworks.title: To the Village
artworks.medium: collage of pen and black ink, graphite and blue and red crayon on two overlapped sheets of paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with one leg slightly bent against a surface. He has a beard and mustache, and his head is slightly tilted to the right with his eyes looking forward. The man is wearing a suit, including a light-colored jacket, dark trousers, and a light shirt with a cravat. He is also wearing a tall top hat and a cummerbund around his waist. A dog is sitting beside him with its ears perked. In the background, there is a street scene depicted in black and white, showing a pathway lined with trees and buildings, with silhouetted figures in the distance.

artworks.title: Chez Maxime
artworks.medium: pen and brush and black ink with gray wash over blue and black chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a café terrace with a group of men in formal attire sitting and standing around small round tables. Most men wear top hats and jackets. One man has a prominent mustache and is dressed in checkered pants, smoking a cigarette. Another man is holding what looks like a newspaper or menu with a cigarette in his mouth. A woman walks past the tables in a dark cloak and hat, carrying a large package. Another woman stands closer, wearing a feathered hat. The background features a building with ornate details, large windows, street lighting, and city facades. The tables are adorned with drinks, a bottle, and ice buckets.

artworks.title: La chienne au loup
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with black and colored chalk
artworks.description: The image shows two people from the knee up. The man sits with his back against a tree trunk, his right arm draped over his knee. The woman leans over him, appearing to embrace him closely. The man has curly dark hair, a mustache, and a beard, wearing a jacket with buttons and an undershirt with a red accent. The woman has her hair styled up and wears a loose-sleeved blouse tucked into a long, flowing skirt. Lush greenery surrounds them, with detailed leaves and flowers. In the background, a night sky and a full moon illuminate a silhouette of a distant village with rooftops and a church spire.

artworks.title: Penitence
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with black and colored crayon
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, a woman and a man, standing close to each other. The woman is facing the man with her hands clasped in front of her, slightly turned towards the right. She has a light complexion and wears a white headscarf, a long striped dress with a blue apron, and a patterned shawl. The man, facing the woman, wears a black hat, a long black robe, and holds a book. The background includes a stone wall, a wooden door, some trees, and a small group of buildings on a hillside.

artworks.title: Les petits joyeux
artworks.medium: black chalk, pen and black ink, colored crayon and paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people in a street scene with musical notation. The image features a group of individuals walking arm in arm down a street, with buildings and other people visible in the background. The people are depicted in a lively manner. The right half of the image shows a bustling street scene. On the left, there is a printed piece of sheet music with the title "Les Petits Joyeux." The sheet music complements the scene by adding a musical element. The handwritten annotations and colored illustration combine to create a multifaceted composition.

artworks.title: La Rafle
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and colored crayon
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a group scene with various figures lined up near a small building or vehicle. The composition includes people dressed in period clothing standing in line. One person in a black and red uniform stands aside with a neutral expression. The style hints at a historical setting, with clean lines and soft colors showing everyday life. The background shows urban architecture and additional figures in a queue, suggesting a busy environment typical of a past era.

artworks.title: Gillis de Glarges
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: The image depicts an older man with a full beard and mustache, wearing a 17th-century outfit including a ruff and fur-lined cloak. He is seated facing slightly to the left with a plain, dark background.

artworks.title: Andreas Rivetus
artworks.description: The image is a three-quarters view of a man's upper body in an oval frame. The man is facing slightly to his left but gazes directly at the viewer. He has a prominent nose, full lips, and a well-defined chin with a closely trimmed goatee. His eyebrows are arched and his expression is serious. His hair is curly and reaches just above his ears, and he wears a dark skullcap on his head. The man is dressed in traditional attire with a dark robe featuring an ornate button panel and wide, white collar. There are no visible objects or jewelry. The background of the oval frame contains text in Latin. Around the oval, there is a heavy border with decorative text. Below the image, there is additional neatly inscribed text. The overall aesthetic suggests a formal, historical portrait engraving.

artworks.title: Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Pieter Claesz Soutman
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a man with a beard and mustache, positioned in a three-quarter view. He wears a cap and a dark garment with a shoulder chain. The portrait is framed with cherubs, garlands, and decorative motifs. Inscriptions and ornamental elements are present below the portrait.
